easyPrerequisites: Players have two or more cards in hand.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Realm Seekers.
When Realm Seekers dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Realm Seekers enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
